notes: ACCESS: argos.co.uk robots.txt (fetched via curl_cffi chrome124, HTTP 200) names no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot disallow - no block. However /browse/ listing pages sit behind an Akamai edge (errors.edgesuite.net Access Denied) that blocked curl_cffi under every impersonation profile tried (chrome110/120/124, edge101) and also blocked headless Playwright/Chromium with the same edge deny page - a genuine network/bot-wall block on tier 1 and tier 2, not a JS-hydration gap (sitemap.xml itself loaded fine via curl_cffi, confirming this is path-specific bot defense, not IP-egress failure). Per the access-tier rule this escalated to tier 3, Claude-in-Chrome (real browser session), which reached every listing page cleanly (HTTP 200, full DOM). TREE SOURCE: enumerated https://www.argos.co.uk/browse_sitemap.xml (1492 urls) and regex-filtered on bath/shower/toilet/basin/sink/tap/vanity/sanitar/bidet/mirror/plumb, then verified via the live in-page nav strip on each visited node ("Bathroom furniture / Bathroom accessories" links in Home & Furniture, "Bathroom fixtures" under Garden & DIY). Argos's Bathroom tree covers three hubs: Home and Furniture > Bathroom furniture (4 leaf children), Home and Furniture > Bathroom accessories (multiple leaf children), and Garden and DIY > Bathroom fixtures (6 leaf children, DIY-grade shower/bath-panel parts - Argos does not sell full baths/toilets/basins/taps as standalone plumbing fixtures, confirmed absent from the sitemap sweep). Parent hub URLs (bathroom-furniture c:29858, bathroom-accessories c:29531, bathroom-fixtures c:29446) are NOT recorded per rule 24 since valid child listings exist; they appear below only as is_group grouping rows (blank qty/link). QTY: each leaf's own site-rendered count, data-test="result-count" element e.g. "25 products", read directly off the loaded PLP in-browser; H1/breadcrumb matched the requested node on every leaf. EXCLUSIONS/ROUTING (all logged to review, none in rows): Shower curtains (c:29545, 62 products) -> TEXTILE per rule 20. Bathroom lights (home-and-furniture/lighting/bathroom-lights c:789407, 38 products) -> LIGHTING per rule 19 (primary type lighting; note one flush-ceiling-light SKU on that page is actually an LED demister touch mirror, but the node's own primary type/hierarchy is lighting so the whole node routes to Lighting, not split). Bathroom scales (c:29551, 46 products) -> ambiguous/excluded: primary product type is a health/body-weight measuring appliance, not listed among rules 13/17 accessory types; sent to review as a judgement call rather than guessed into rows (rule 29). Makeup mirrors (health-and-beauty/makeup/makeup-mirrors c:29261) -> excluded: site hierarchy places it under Makeup, a portable beauty-vanity mirror, not the Bathroom hierarchy's own bathroom-mirrors node. General home-furnishing mirrors (home-and-furniture/home-furnishings/mirrors and its 4 children) -> excluded: separate general Mirrors node belongs to Wall Decor, not Bathroom (Argos's own hierarchy already keeps bathroom-mirrors as a distinct node, so these general ones are correctly not bathroom-specific). Health-and-beauty mobility aids (bath-boards, bath-lifts-and-steps, raised-toilet-seats-and-frames, shower-chairs) -> excluded: filed under Health and Beauty > Mobility Aids, medical/disability equipment, not Argos's Bathroom Accessories/Furniture/Fixtures hierarchy. health-and-beauty/skincare/bath-and-shower -> excluded: toiletries/skincare products (bath oils, shower gel), not bathroom fixtures/hardware. baby-and-nursery/bathing-and-changing and /potties-and-toilet-training (baby baths, potties, changing mats, nappy bins etc.) -> excluded: baby-care department, out of Bathroom's product-type scope. garden-decoration-and-landscaping/bird-feeders-baths-and-houses -> excluded: outdoor bird baths, false-keyword match, not a human-bathroom product. mirrorless-cameras / dictaphones / nail-and-staple-guns -> false positives from substring "tap" in the sitemap keyword sweep, not bathroom-related, no candidate. CROSS-CATEGORY DEDUP: cross_category_url_index.json checked for all 18 candidate leaf URLs; 2 hits - under-sink-storage (c:812663) and shower-and-bath-storage (c:62266) are already recorded in Storage.xlsx, so both moved to review as ALREADY EXTRACTED IN Storage.xlsx per the mandatory dedup rule, leaving 16 rows. No other candidate URL appeared in the index.
